title: Entity Matching using Large Language Models
abstract: We study the use of large language models for the entity matching task.

title: Analyzing How BERT Performs Entity Matching
abstract: We analyze how BERT-based models perform entity matching by studying attention patterns.

title: Time2Feat: Learning Interpretable Representations for Multivariate Time Series Clustering
abstract: Time2Feat learns interpretable feature representations from multivariate time series for clustering.

title: AutoML for Entity Matching: A Multi-Objective Approach
abstract: An AutoML approach for entity matching that optimizes multiple objectives including precision, recall, and efficiency.

title: UEDI: Unsupervised Evaluation of Dataset Integration
abstract: UEDI is an unsupervised framework for evaluating the quality of dataset integration without labeled ground truth.

title: ClariESG: Extracting ESG Information from Financial Documents
abstract: ClariESG automatically extracts Environmental, Social, and Governance information from financial reports.

title: NOCTOWL: Anomaly Detection for Industrial Time Series
abstract: NOCTOWL is an anomaly detection framework for industrial time series combining statistical and deep learning methods.

title: AE4ND: Novelty Detection with Autoencoders for System Health Monitoring
abstract: AE4ND uses autoencoders for novelty detection in industrial environments for proactive system health monitoring.

title: FactFlip: Fact Verification with Contrastive Learning
abstract: FactFlip uses contrastive learning to distinguish between true and false claims through evidence-based reasoning.

title: MASQ: Running ML Models Inside the Database
abstract: MASQ enables efficient execution of machine learning models directly inside relational database systems.

title: Enhancing Data Integration: A Research Design Proposal for End-to-End Product Entity Matching
abstract: An end-to-end pipeline for product entity matching in e-commerce settings using large language models.
